'''Cairn Clan''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] clan under the leadership of [[Evo (Rodian)|Evo]] the Blue. In [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]], they fought an honor duel against [[Jannik (Rodian)|Jannik the White's]] [[Reeven Clan]]. They lost due to the actions of [[Nym/Legends|Nym]].
